system.description: This Charm costs three motes every time its benefits are activated. It allows the character to hurl implements in order to take a normal action out to a range of (Essence x 10) yards; for example, the character could throw her lockpicks at a lock to make a Larceny roll, toss a pen at a desk to write a letter from across the room, or hurl her daiklave at an opponent on the other side of a moat to make a standard Melee attack. Acuity of the Far-Flung Hand does not help the character retrieve tossed items. Penalties that would apply to a Thrown roll (such as those due to wind or poor visibility) apply to the roll for the action taken.
